Isaac Heeney (centre) starred yet again as Sydney recorded a three-point win over Port Adelaide at the Adelaide Oval. (Getty Images: Sarah Reed)

Sydney has drawn level with ladder-leaders Fremantle on premiership points after a comeback win against Port Adelaide at the Adelaide Oval.

The Swans trailed by as many as 20 points in the second quarter, but kicked nine goals to six in the second half to run out 14.9 (93) to 13.12 (90) winners at the Adelaide Oval.

Isaac Heeney was the leading ball-winner on the ground 30 disposals, while ruckman Brodie Grundy added 26 disposals and nine clearances.

A late goal from Grundy's counterpart, Jordon Sweet, drew Port Adelaide to within a goal with 37 seconds remaining, but the Swans were eventually able to hold on for a crucial win.

Sydney's win was the second thriller of the day after North Melbourne held on for a one-point win against West Coast in Perth.

In what was a rare away game for the Eagles at Perth Stadium, West Coast forward Jake Waterman missed a potential go-ahead set shot with less than a minute left on the clock, as the Kangaroos escaped with a 10.14 (74) to 10.13 (73) win.

In Saturday's first match, talented Bombers backman Archie Roberts dislocated his right shoulder in a first-half tackle attempt as Melbourne recorded a 13.17 (95) to 6.14 (50) win at the MCG with both sides paying tribute to Neale Daniher.

Follow the live blog below for a recap of all of Saturday's AFL action as it happened.

By Chris De Silva

After last nights comfortable win by the Cats I thought the run of nail-biting finishes blogged by Chris had ended - I was wrong, it was just an anomaly. Thanks for the blogs Chris and Andrew, see you next time.

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 10:27pm

By Chris De Silva

Here's a look at all the main numbers from Sydney's three-point win over Port Adelaide.

Key Event

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 10:11pm

By Chris De Silva

THE SWANS HAVE DONE IT!

Brodie Grundy fists the ball away from congestion from the final ruck contest, and it's as good as a kick and that's enough for Sydney to run down the clock.

What a game, what a win for one of the league's premiership fancies!

The Swans wind up kicking 5.1 to Port's 3.1 in the final quarter to record a three-point win.

All of Sydney's big names were huge in that final quarter.

Brodie Grundy recorded eight points and five clearances, Chad Warner had 10 touches and three clearances, while Isaac Heeney added eight touches of his own.

Heeney finishes the match as the leading ball-winner with 30 touches and also added nine score involvements, while Grundy also added nine clearances and six intercepts.

A word too to Jordon Sweet, Port's ruckman, who finishes with 17 touches, 13 score involvements and nine clearances.

Port draws level with Fremantle on 48 premiership points, but the Dockers have a game in hand having had their bye this week.

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 10:10pm

By Chris De Silva

Ball-up around 60m out from Port's goal with 18 seconds left!

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 10:09pm

By Chris De Silva

Jordon Sweet with a big mark and goal with 37 seconds left!

Big centre bounce coming up with the Swans clinging to a three-point lead.

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 10:08pm

By Chris De Silva

Joe Berry does everything right by sidestepping the man on the mark and sends the ball inside 50.

But then he undoes all his good work by kicking the ball out on the full.

We're into the last 1:20. It's still mathematically possible for Port, but very unlikely now.

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 10:06pm

By Chris De Silva

James Rowbottom may just have sealed the four points for the Swans!

Caiden Cleary kicks a long ball inside 50 and Rowbottom crumbs the marking contest perfectly.

Ghosts in from around the front and then dribbles it home on the left boot from close range.

Swans by nine points with 2:34 left on the clock

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 10:05pm

By Chris De Silva

Callum Mills with a terrific defensive play on the wing against Jack Whitlock!

That was a scintillating passage of play for the last minute.

We're into the last three minutes of this cotnest.

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 10:02pm

By Chris De Silva

Jason Horne-Francis shows nerves of steel as he drills a set shot from directly in front 45m out from goal.

Sydney's lead trimmed back to three points with 5:10 left on the clock.

Is the next goal the winning one?

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 9:59pm

By Chris De Silva

Mitch Georgiades drills a very difficult set shot from the boundary to trim Port's deficit to nine points with 7:40 left.

Zak Butters with the set-up to find Georgiades inside 50. He's gotten busy in the last few minutes, now up to 23 touches for the match.

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 9:55pm

By Chris De Silva

Port officially in trouble here!

Isaac Heeney peels away from a stoppage in the middle of the ground and finds James Rowbottom with a handball.

Rowbottom's kick inside 50 is not good, but Esava Ratugolea spills the mark attempt, instead knocking it forward.

The ball lands in the hands of Logan McDonald, who snaps truly to give the Swans a 15-point lead with 10 minutes left.

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 9:50pm

By Chris De Silva

JAKE LLOYD, WHAT A FINISH!

The Swans veteran receives the ball at half forward around 70m out from goal and takes it inside 50.

He's about 47m out from goal and tucked into the boundary line, but decides to have a shot on goal, and the ball sneaks inside the right-hand upright.

Sydney now out to a game-high 10-point lead. Still plenty of time for Port though with 13 minutes left on the countdown clock.

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 9:46pm

By Chris De Silva

The Swans force a turnover on the wing and Chad Warner finds himself all alone inside 50.

He takes the set shot from a hair beyond the 50m arc and absolutely flushes it to put Sydney in front.

The Swans have kicked seven of the last 10 goals to take the lead here.

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 9:44pm

By Chris De Silva

The Swans stream forward off halfback and Charlie Curnow is one out with Aliir Aliir.

Curnow manages to push Aliir off the ball legally and then runs through towards goal and receives a handball to kick an easy one running into an open goal.

Swans back within a kick at the Adelaide Oval.

Key Event

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 9:31pm

By Chris De Silva

Joe Berry misses a set shot from directly in front after the siren and Port has to settle for a nine-point lead at three-quarter time.

That could be potentially pivotal in a see-sawing contest like this one.

Another fascinating quarter in the books in this one. Swans kick 4.2 to Port's 3.2 to close the half-time margin.

Callum Mills leads all players with 23 touches, while Darcy Byrne-Jones is Port's high man with 19 touches.

Port big man Jordon Sweet is the clearance leader with seven and he's also got 11 score involvements.

The Power still have the lead in inside 50s (43-34) and the clearances (28-19).

One quarter to go, still anyone's game here.

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 9:24pm

By Chris De Silva

Zak Butters with a massive goal on the run and Port Adelaide is back out to a nine-point lead!

Butters streams in towards goal and shrugs off an Isaac Heeney tackle before slotting it on the left boot.

He's now got 14 touches and three clearances to go along with that goal.

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 9:21pm

By Chris De Silva

Corey Durdin does it again!

Mitch Georgiades shakes off his defender and puts a left-footed kick inside 50 where Durdin is running back with the flight of the ball, and he puts one hand out and takes it. Brilliant mark!

Durdin kicks truly from the set shot to put Port Adelaide back int front.

We've got a proper Saturday night special here tonight!

Sat 13 Jun 2026 at 9:19pm

By Chris De Silva

The Swans have hit the front at the Adelaide Oval!

Chad Warner finds Isaac Heeney in the pocket, and Heeney's also on the wrong side for a right-footer, so he breaks out the left-footed snap and absolutely drills it.

Sydney in front for the first time since the opening minutes.
